name: QKD BB84 Protocol Benchmark
description: Benchmark evaluating quantum key distribution throughput and security using the BB84 protocol, the foundational QKD scheme proposed by Bennett and Brassard in 1984. The secure bound of the quantum bit error rate (QBER) for BB84 is approximately 11%, extendable to 12.6% with six-state variants. Benchmarks assess secret key rates, QBER tolerance, and distance limits under coherent attacks with decoy-state methods.
significance: Establishes the fundamental security limits for the most widely deployed quantum cryptography protocol, critical for commercial QKD system certification.
